look_lock: ALEXA 65 large-format sci-fi chamber drama. 35mm/50mm lens family. Cold directional void light from camera right. Desaturated cold-blue high-contrast grade with warm tea-table accents. Void haze. Controlled restrained camera movement.

characters.horus: Horus Lupercal: bald, pale, 11.5ft Primarch scale, black-and-gold armor.
characters.embry: Embry Lawson: young woman, dark brown low ponytail, olive eyes, subtle nose scar, gray fieldwear, human scale.

props: round patio table, umbrella (weathered, wind response), tea service (steam rising), SPARTA laptop.
environment: void-world terrace, stone railing, cold horizon.
creatures: Tyranids at distance (chitin carapace, scything talons).

01.shot: Wide establishing shot. Void horizon, tiny patio table, umbrella. Tzeentch sky-eye blinks above. Horus seated, Embry opposite. Tyranids at distance.

02.shot: Medium shot on Horus. 11.5ft Primarch scale fills frame. One armored hand near teacup. Tea steam curl around gauntlet. Scalp pores visible.

03.shot: Medium shot on Embry. Opens SPARTA Explorer on monitor_sparta false-green gates. Screen glow on face. Tea steam crosses sightline.

04.shot: Background wide. Tyranids run/play at distance. Stone railing in foreground. Sky-eye watches above.

05.shot: Insert detail. Tea cups, handwritten notes, source refs cards. Steam rising, paper corners lifting. Sky-eye glint ripples on tea.

06.shot: MCU on Horus. Evidence card held, paper flexes. Steam past cheek. Brow tightens, dry smile before dialogue.

07.shot: Reverse MCU on Embry. Taps source_refs. Thumb pause on laptop edge. Shoulders drop. Tea steam curls between camera and face.

08.shot: Shared screen insert. SPARTA Explorer shows monitor_sparta.py. Horus/Embry reflected in glass.

09.shot: Wide background motion. Tyranids cross behind umbrella. Sky-eye blinks. Umbrella strains in gust.

10.shot: Closing two-shot. Umbrella canopy pulls camera-left. Steam thins/dissipates. Sky-eye dims. Horus/Embry lean over notes.
